name: Failure #1
description: Continuous high-stress pneumatic air leak in the APU system causing rapid cycling and sustained compressor duty cycles.

name: Failure #2
description: Severe air leak resulting in failure to maintain pressure threshold; resolved via emergency maintenance at noon on May 30.

name: Failure #3
description: Multi-day extended high-stress air leak episode spanning June 5 to June 7; maintenance intervention executed on June 8 at 16:00.

name: Failure #4
description: Sudden pressure loss and air leak episode on July 15, addressed by depot maintenance on July 16 at midnight.
